item.title: 【Interviews / TV shows / Others】SDTV - [REQUEST] MTV's The City Season 1 - Original Broadcasts / Airings / DVD Video
item.description: Does anyone know where to locate original airings or DVD rips of the MTV show The City (Season 1 only!) Season 1 aired in 2008 & 2009 and I cannot find any original versions anywhere. It is a spinoff of the more popular The Hills which original versions are available on Bilibili and some on Dailymotion, and Season 2 of The City (original version) is available on both of these sites. S2EP1 is cut short on Bilibili so if a full length version of that is found, that is also appreciated, but I really would love to hunt down Season 1 since I am archiving both this show and The Hills! Any help is appreciated. Thank you!
